title: Launcher where-strip, directory prompt and split inheritance
body:
Add the `Local | <remote names>` strip to the Project launcher so agents and shells can be started on a Remote by mouse, ask once for the Remote directory when a Project has no mapping, and make splits and new terminals inherit the focused Session's Remote.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (sections: UI > Launcher, UI > Splits inherit, Launch > Directory)
Blocked by: Open a Remote Session from the CLI with --on; Remotes pane in Settings with Test and reachability
Done when:
- with no Remotes configured the launcher model is exactly what it is today (the existing test passes unchanged)
- with Remotes, the strip shows above AGENTS, the selection is per Project for the app run and starts at Local, and offline names are dimmed but clickable
- choosing an agent or Shell under a Remote opens it there; a Remote shows one Shell row
- the first launch with no mapping prompts for the directory and saves it
- a split or new terminal from a focused Remote Session opens on that Remote; from anything else it opens Local
Notes from landed cards:
- Dim offline names with remote_probe::reach(ctx, target); do not build a second probe.
- remote::launch_dir's error text still tells the user to edit settings.json; now that the Remotes pane and the directory prompt exist, point it at those.
- remote::launch_dir's same_dir does not strip a \\?\ verbatim prefix the way layout_library.rs and control.rs do; strip it so a mapped directory still matches, with a test.
- Run after card 2fiwd0 (Remotes pane design fixes) so the directory prompt can match the fixed form style.
- Design bar (a designer reviews this card from the code afterwards; earlier cards failed on exactly these): theme tokens only, no hard-coded colours or sizes where the launcher's existing rows use theme values; the strip must fit the launcher's minimum width (many or long Remote names scroll or elide, never clip or overlap); every state readable without colour alone (selected, offline, checking); a mouse target and a keyboard path for everything, with the hint line telling the truth; no layout jump when a probe result arrives; the directory prompt matches the Remotes pane form (stacked label/field, error in the danger colour inside the form, focus on the bad field, Esc leaves nothing behind); snap any small glyph to device pixels as icons::paint_globe_badge does.
- Session::spawn_remote now takes &Remote. A restored or reconnected Remote Session already relaunches through remote::relaunch; do not add a second path.
- The final report must list the states the human should capture with build-screenshot.
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent launcher; cargo test --target-dir target/agent remote
